methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified 2026-06-15 by fetching each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch (dnsimple.com/pricing, digicert.com/digicert-dns, cloudns.net premium/ddos-protected-plans/geodns pages, cloudflare.com/plans/, aws.amazon.com/route53/pricing/, bunny.net/pricing/dns/, dnsfilter.com/pricing). Google Cloud DNS pricing page returned truncated WebFetch output; figures corroborated via WebSearch citing cloud.google.com/dns/pricing. NS1/IBM pricing page confirmed HTTP 403; structure confirmed via WebSearch (free Developer tier exists, all paid tiers contact-sales). Constellix.com/pricing 301-redirects to constellix.digicert.com/pricing which 404s; pay-as-you-go figures corroborated via WebSearch citing assets.constellix.com/pricing and constellix.com/pricing/faq. CORRECTIONS vs draft: (1) Google Cloud DNS HIPAA/BAA set to null — Cloud DNS is not explicitly named in Google's public HIPAA covered-products list, so the 'explicitly covered' claim is unverifiable. (2) Constellix billingModel changed flat->custom: $5 is a usage-based minimum, not a flat subscription. (3) DNSimple Solo freeTier clarified to false — Solo has no base fee but charges $0.50/zone/month, so it is not forever-free. (4) Constellix provenance corrected: redirect host is constellix.digicert.com (not vercara). All vendors verified to exist; none removed. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
